audit_notes.phase1_determinism: deterministicTestWrapper added (internal, not exported). Same inputs (token, chain, executionNowMs, price, deadline) yield same outputs. mintScanner 30d/60d window now uses executionNowMs when provided (fix applied).
audit_notes.phase2_cache: supplyRiskResultCache: key from token_symbol, token_address, chain, timeframe_days, simulation_params (no API keys, URLs, or raw timestamps). enrichmentCache: key symbol:chain:bucket(executionNowMs). unlockScanner: chain:address:bucket(executionNowMs). Cache TTL uses Date.now() only for expiry check; payloads do not embed Date.now().
audit_notes.phase3_nan: All divisions guarded (denominator > 0 or fallback). fin()/clamp used in quantitativeAnalytics. Engine: supplySafe/volume30d, unlockAmountUsd/marketCapUsd, unlockAmountUsd/liquidityUsd, totalWeight all guarded. Optional fields set finite and >= 0 when present.
audit_notes.phase4_overflow: liquidityUsd=1, unlockAmountUsd=1e6 → unlockLiquidityImpact clamped via normalize to 100; finalLiquidityStress clamped 0-100. unlock_market_cap_impact clamped 0-1e6. No Infinity/overflow.
audit_notes.phase5_risk_tier: getRiskTier: s<=25 LOW, s<=50 MODERATE, s<=75 HIGH, else EXTREME. Boundary values 25, 50, 75 deterministic. fin() and clamp(0,100) applied.
audit_notes.phase6_forward_curve: buildForwardRiskWithUncertainty uses only fin/clamp and options; no Date.now(). confidence_interval_low <= confidence_interval_high by construction. model_confidence_score finite.
audit_notes.phase7_soft_failure: defaultOutput (timeout path) now includes risk_flags: ['NO_DATA']. unlock_amount_usd absent (undefined); liquidity_stress_score=0; risk_tier LOW; no NaN.
audit_notes.phase8_schema: SupplyRiskOutputFlat optional fields (unlock_amount_usd, unlock_market_cap_impact, market_cap_usd, liquidity_usd, volume_24h_usd) set only when finite and >= 0; never undefined when present in engine output.
audit_notes.phase9_hidden_nondeterminism: Date.now() in engine: executionNowMs fallback and deadline/latency checks (allowed). unlockScanner: cache TTL and deadline checks (allowed). mintScanner: nowSec uses executionNowMs when provided (fix applied). quantitativeAnalytics buildDataFreshness: uses params.nowSec when provided; engine always passes nowSec. Math.random only in ethereumRpcProvider (requestId), not in dynamic path.
audit_notes.phase10_performance: deadlineMs respected; early return on Date.now() >= deadline. No new async after liquidity fusion. No recursive calls.
fixes_applied: mintScanner: 30d/60d window now uses executionNowMs when passed from runUnlockScanner; same executionNowMs yields same inflation rates.
defaultOutput: risk_flags set to ['NO_DATA'] for soft-failure (timeout) consistency.
